title: MediaIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: media.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Media; roadmap WS-O task 10). The OpenVibe.Search document of a public, playable VOD or clip whose canonical page is on openvibe.media (openvibe.media/v/<id>, /c/<id>): readiness playable, visibility public, made by a person, and owned by an app other than Live (Live's own VODs and clips are live.index_document, type vod or clip, on Live's pages). Sent whenever what Search should hold changed; a VOD or clip that is deleted, made private or stops being playable gets a tombstone. The revision grows with every change. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision: <document revision> }, visibility internal, actor service:media.
